brief:
An Israeli drone killed a Palestinian in Gaza, Al Jazeera English reported. The incident occurred amid ongoing violence in the territory, where 1,439 Palestinians have been killed and 5,052 injured since a ceasefire began in October 2025.

Israeli settlers killed another Palestinian in the West Bank in a separate incident. Both deaths occurred within the same reporting period during which thousands have been killed and wounded across the occupied territories.

title: Drone strike and settler attack kill two Palestinians in separate incidents
